- When sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 5–10 days.  
- When sentiment is negative (≤0.33) or mixed, model often underestimates; adjust upward by 1–2% if recent price is trending down.  
- After a sharp price spike (forecast > 85), model frequently overcorrects and overshoots; cap forecast at +5% above peak for next 3–5 days.  
- If sentiment shifts from positive to negative mid-period, model fails to adjust; reduce forecast slope by 10–20% in the following 5–7 days.  
- Mean reversion is strong in 30-day horizon; if forecast is >85 for 3+ consecutive days, apply downward bias of 1–2% per day until price stabilizes.  
- If sentiment is high but price is falling, model often ignores sentiment; if sentiment >0.75 and price <82, reduce forecast by 1–2% per day.
